subject: Operations
title: The Supermarket Concept
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Supermarket Concept.

hook.text: In 1930, the first supermarket let customers grab their own goods. Store clerks became obsolete.

buildup.text: King Kullen and Piggly Wiggly pioneered self-service. Customers picked items from open shelves.

discovery.text: Shelves were restocked only when emptied—a pull system driven by real demand, not forecasts.

twist.text: Taiichi Ohno visited US supermarkets in the 1950s. He modeled Toyota's production on what he saw.

climax.text: The kanban system—heart of lean manufacturing—was inspired by grocery store shelf restocking.

punchline.text: A grocery aisle inspired a factory revolution.

quiz.question: What inspired Toyota's kanban pull system?
